Allow.description: A condition a check refuses, which the user can allow, one at a time.

oneOf.description:
The new name shadows, or is shadowed by, another definition, changing
what some references mean.

The new name is another method's in the same scope, making it an
overload.

The first letter of a Go name changes case, and with it whether it
is exported.
The edit changes generated or vendored files.

Sources.description: Which sources a build system declares.

all_overloads.description: Rename every overload of the name together.

allow.description: Allow a condition the checks refuse; repeatable.

exclude_unresolved.description: Edit the sites codix binds and leave unchanged the references it cannot bind, in other files or through other objects.

here.description: Limit results to the current directory's subtree.

kind.description: Consider symbols of this kind only; repeatable.

path.description: Limit results to this subtree; repeatable.

sources.description: Keep main or test sources only, as the build systems declare them.

symbol.description: Symbol ID, its path part, `file:line:col`, or a name; a local by `file:line:col` only.

textual.description: At tier 1, where codix cannot bind names, rename every whole-word match of the name in its file.
